claim_001.author: researcher_01
claim_001.text: The Arctic sea ice extent has declined at an average rate of 13% per decade since 1979.
claim_001.evidence: NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Satellite observations 1979-2024

claim_002.author: researcher_02
claim_002.text: Atmospheric CO2 concentrations exceeded 420 ppm in 2024, the highest in recorded history.
claim_002.evidence: NOAA Mauna Loa Observatory, Keeling Curve data 2024

claim_003.author: researcher_03
claim_003.text: Global average temperature in 2024 was 1.45°C above pre-industrial levels.
claim_003.evidence: WMO State of the Global Climate 2024 Report
